description: Public-speaking worry in four different phrasings, plus one one-off event. Tests paraphrased recurrence and calibration.

key.recurring_worry: public speaking: palms sweating, freezing in meetings, avoiding the seminar, dreading questions (4 conversations)
key.event: department seminar Oct 12, reported Oct 13: went okay, she did not freeze

messages: Hi, I'm Tara. I'm a research assistant in a biology lab in Pune.
My palms get sweaty whenever I have to present anything.
Okay, that's all for now.
My bike had a flat tyre on the way to the lab, what a start to the day.
I fixed it myself with a kit, I'm proud.
Good night.
I cooked a big pot of khichdi for the week.
I'm reading a novel at night to unwind.
Talk soon.
In the lab meeting I froze when my supervisor asked me a question.
I knew the answer but my mind went blank.
Bye for now.
I went for a long trek on Saturday.
It was beautiful and quiet.
That's all.
I have to give a department seminar next month.
I keep thinking of reasons to ask someone else to do it.
Good night.
I moved to a new apartment this week, closer to the lab.
It's small but I can walk to work now.
The seminar is on October 12 and I haven't even started the slides.
I've been avoiding it, honestly. I dread standing in front of everyone.
Okay, bye for now.
I made a rough set of slides today.
My supervisor said I should rehearse out loud.
Talk soon.
I practised in front of the mirror and my voice still shakes.
I worry that I'll go blank in front of the whole department.
Goodnight.
The seminar is today.
I'm having some tea and then I'll head to the lab.
Wish me luck.
The seminar went okay, I didn't freeze.
My hands shook a little but I got through the whole talk.
I'm just glad it's done.
Back to normal lab work this week.
My supervisor asked if I'd like to present at a conference next spring.
I said I would think about it.

probes.question: Is my trouble with speaking in front of people a recurring worry or a one-off? Answer RECURRING or ONE-OFF, and state your confidence as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
probes.expected: RECURRING, confidence HIGH (four conversations, different wording).

probes.question: Is my bike's flat tyre a recurring problem or a one-off? Answer RECURRING or ONE-OFF, and state your confidence as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
probes.expected: ONE-OFF (mentioned once); confidence should not be LOW recurring; HIGH or MEDIUM for one-off is fine.

probes.question: Where do I live now?
probes.expected: In a new apartment closer to the lab in Pune (moved in late September).

probes.question: How did my seminar go?
probes.expected: It went okay; she did not freeze; hands shook a little; she got through it.

probes.question: Has anything about me changed since we first started talking?
probes.expected: Should mention the new apartment; maybe that she presented the seminar without freezing; supervisor suggested a conference talk.
